notes.title: 🍄 PATCH 1.03 🍄
notes.content:
Welcome to the second public patch update for the full game!

In this patch, we're focusing mainly on the first few minutes of gameplay, assisting new players and smoothing out some difficulty edges based on preliminary feedback. We're also improving some weapons and boosting Nero's moving speed.

This is an incremental process, so expect more updates soon!

[Gameplay changes]

 Removed the first wave of flying Crazy Skulls after a few seconds in the Dark Age.
 Rats and Skeletons are less likely to anticipate your path (i.e., they are now dumber, as you would expect from rats and brainless skeletons).
 Rat speed reduced by 40%.
 Skull speed reduced by 10%.
 Griffon: reduced HP and damage by 20%.
 Boomerang weapon: improved targeting direction (now points exactly at the nearest enemy).
 Yo-yo weapon: 50% higher base crit chance, can now steal 1 HP per crit hit, and gets momentarily bigger on a crit hit.
 Mosquito: reduced damage by 50%.
 Pyramid Boss: reduced HP by 20%.
 Tutankamhon Boss: fixes, rebalanced, and visually improved.
 Nero base move speed boosted from 70 to 80.

[QoL]

 Fixed: Chrono Forge not showing "BUY" when appropriate.
 Fixed: Yo-Yo icon is blurred on some systems.
 Clearer descriptions for Yo-Yo and Red Leech weapons.
 Clarified some unlock descriptions.
 Removed "Available in next run" text.
 Dummy enemy in the Sandbox now has 1,000,000 HP (don't worry about hitting him, he doesn't feel anything).


Check out this quick guide for beginners and advanced players
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3142026192

Thank you for playing our game
- Cris, DDT, Lele 🌙🌶️  (Lunar Chili team)

notes.title: 🍄 "Chapter 0" vs 🍄 "Prologue" vs 🍄 "Time Survivors"?
notes.content:
If you played our game "Time Survivors: Prologue", the forthcoming "Time Survivors: Chapter 0" may sound confusing. With this post everything will be much clearer! It's quite simple actually...

Time Survivors: Prologue marked the initial free release of our game. It offered a limited selection of characters and features, and it won't receive further updates.

Time Survivors:  Chapter 0 is the evolution of our free game, inspired by the invaluable feedback from our players who experienced the "Prologue". We've diligently worked to implement significant enhancements, introducing fresh gameplay mechanics. These include unique activable abilities for our historical heroes and a tree-based meta progression system, allowing you to unlock and refine various gameplay elements.

Time Survivors represents the full game. A free demo will be available at the end of September, and it will be featured at the Steam Next Fest in October. The official launch is scheduled by the end of 2023 and promises a wealth of additional content compared to "Chapter 0". Expect more stages, historical characters with distinctive abilities, items, weapons, and much more.

notes.title: Cursed Relics FAQ
notes.content:
What are the Relics?
Relics are unique items that you can find only in specific places on the map. These are brand new locations. Relics provide special powers: some offensive (eg: leave a fire trail when you walk), some life saving (eg: recover hp when you deal critical damage). They have their own dedicated slots, so you won't have to sacrifice any of your weapon or item slots. Relics provide a new dimension to the game as you will be able to explore their synergies with your preferred builds.

How do I find them?
Relics can be found by breaking Relics Shrines, new elements such as statues 🗿 or obelisks placed in special new places of the map. They will appear in different positions every run.
You'll need a compass to help you find them... 🧭 

Hey, but you said Cursed Relics? What's the catch?
Well, first of all Relics are usually well guarded, so you'll have to fight through some fiery monsters to get them.
And yes, they are Cursed at first: you will need to purge them before being able to use them. There are several possible trials to overcome to purge a Relic: for example you'll have to kill 100 enemies 💀 or survive 30 seconds in the dark - without taking any damage. Because well, if you take any damage after picking up a Cursed Relic but before purging it: you'll die. Instantly.  ☠️. They're cursed, remember? With great power comes great responsibility.

Can I choose the Relics to pick?
When you break a Relic Shrine, you'll be presented with a choice of two Relics: by checking the abilities they provide and their purge requirement you can decide which one to pick - or you can decide not to pick any of the proposed Relics and try to get to the next Relic Shrine. It's up to you, depending on your current build and the risks you are willing to take.

How many Relics will be available?
We will start with these 8 and add more in the future:

 Doppelganger:[spoiler]release a hologram of your character. Enemies attack the hologram instead of you[/spoiler]
 Mystic Urn:[spoiler]if you carry this Relic, Mortician max health is reduced by 30%[/spoiler]
 Enchanted Hourglass:[spoiler]increase all power-ups duration by 5s[/spoiler]
 Vitality Shard:[spoiler]enemies defeated with a critical hit give you 0.5 HP[/spoiler]
 Steel Apple:[spoiler]max HP increased by 50%, but the effect of all healing items is cut in half[/spoiler]
 Heart of Gold:[spoiler]lose gold instead of HP when hit: 1 HP = 50 gold[/spoiler]
 Boots of Fire:[spoiler]generate a fire trail damaging enemies while you walk[/spoiler]
 Blast Charm:[spoiler]drop a bomb damaging enemies on a wide area[/spoiler]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217851/e1059d7abe424cb71ef4cd1afabe1a68e1d25a29.gif
Did I say "Doppelganger"?

TL; DR
Unlock Compass ➡️ follow directions ➡️ break a Relic Shrine ➡️ choose a Cursed Relic ➡️ purge the Cursed Relic ➡️ enjoy the Relic power until the end of the run (or insta-die if you fail to purge the Cursed Relic)

🧭  -> ↗️ -> 🗿 -> 📿 -> 💀x100 -> 🤯  ( ☠️ )
